impact.reason: Reduction supported by comparable pre/post measurements over the documented monitoring period.
assumptions: Reduction = pre-repair measured rate − mean post-repair measured rate (same method).
Duration = time from repair completion to the last post-repair measurement only; no extrapolation.
Interval shown is ±1σ from measurement uncertainty (combined in quadrature); GWP uncertainty (±11) is reported separately, not propagated.
Satellite plume detections are context for the incident; they are not used as the baseline.
impact.gwp_reference: IPCC AR6 WG1 Ch.7 Table 7.15 — CH4 (fossil origin) GWP-100 = 29.8 ± 11
